# Bose

> Bose is a premium audio equipment manufacturer offering headphones, earbuds, speakers, and home theater systems with advanced noise-cancelling and spatial audio technologies.

Bose.com serves as the official e-commerce and information hub for Bose's consumer and professional audio products. The site features comprehensive product catalogs across multiple categories, from portable wireless audio to aviation headsets and professional PA systems, with emphasis on noise-cancelling technology and spatial audio innovation.

## Key Topics

- Noise-Cancelling (ANC)
- Spatial Audio
- Bluetooth Wireless
- QuietComfort Series
- Bose Ultra Open Earbuds
- Dolby Atmos
- Multi-point Connection
- BoseCare Protection Plans
- Home Theater Soundbars
- Aviation Headsets
- Portable Speakers
- Product Bundles
- Limited-Edition Colors
- Refurbished Products
- Audio Accessories

## Core Product Categories

- [Shop Headphones | Bluetooth, Wireless, Headsets | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/headphones): Headphones product catalog with noise-cancelling and spatial audio
- [Shop Earbuds | Wireless and Bluetooth Earbud Options | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/earbuds): Earbuds product catalog including QuietComfort and Ultra Open
- [Shop Speakers | Bluetooth, Wireless, House, and Waterproof Options | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/speakers): Speakers product catalog with portable and wireless options
- [Shop Home Theater Systems and Home Theater Speakers | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/home-theater): Home theater systems and soundbars with Dolby Atmos support
- [PA Systems, Powered Speakers, & PA Speakers | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/portable-pa): Professional PA systems and powered speakers for live music
- [Shop All Aviation Headsets For Pilots | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/aviation-headsets): FAA-certified aviation headsets including A30 and ProFlight

## Specialized Audio Solutions

- [Shop Noise-Cancelling Headphones | ANC Headphones | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/headphones/noise-cancelling): Noise-cancelling headphones including QuietComfort series
- [Spatial Audio Headphones | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/headphones/spatial-audio): Spatial audio headphones with immersive sound technology

- [Headphone Accessories & Headphone Parts | Bose](https://www.bose.com/c/headphones/accessories): Headphone accessories, cases, chargers, and replacement parts
